# Decidim Extra Blocks

Extra Blocks adds one content block — **Extra Block** — to organization, participatory process, process group, and assembly homepages. Admins pick a layout from a gallery, freeze it on that block, then edit layout-specific settings. Participants see a cached, mobile-first section.

## Who this is for

| You… | Start here |
|------|------------|
| Install the gem and configure landing pages | [Integrate](./integrate/index.md) |
| Add or change layouts in the gem | [Contribute](./contribute/add-a-layout.md) |

Not a page builder, GrapesJS replacement, or theme marketplace — curated, freeze-safe landing layouts only.

## How it works

1. Add **Extra Block** from the usual landing-page content blocks UI.
2. Choose a layout (grouped by category: CTA, Hero, Fast Proposal, Text, Misc, Timelines).
3. Confirm — the layout cannot change on that block.
4. Configure colors, text, buttons, or video.
5. Publish — the public cell renders the selected layout.
